title: Resume Builder
subtitle: Fill out your details to generate your resume instantly.
aboutText: Creating a professional, well-formatted resume is essential for job applications. This interactive online builder formats your personal details, work experience, education, and technical skills into a clean document ready to export or print as a PDF.
step1: Fill in your full name, job title, email, phone number, and a brief professional summary.
step2: Add key technical or soft skills one by one using the input field.
step3: List your relevant work history, job roles, durations, and key responsibilities.
step4: Include your educational background, degrees, and graduation dates.
step5Prefix: Review the live preview on the right and click
faq1Q: Is my resume data saved on any external servers?
faq1A: No, all inputs are processed locally in your browser memory for total privacy and data security.
faq2Q: How do I save my resume as a PDF file?
faq2A: Click the green print button, then choose "Save as PDF" from your browser print destination options.
